messages:
Sam K: Quick question — streaming to private VPC endpoint + NAT egress is causing Node SDK streams to reset after ~10s, Python client fine. Anyone seen this?
Maria V: Hmm, do you have an HTTP proxy in the egress path? CONNECT vs TLS matters. Are you terminating TLS in the proxy?
Sam K: Yes, our NAT path goes through a transparent proxy that rewrites SNI. headers: we set REDWOOD_API_BASE to https://inference.private.local
Jake L: If SNI gets rewritten Node's `https` may not set `servername` correctly when you pass a custom `host` header. Py's requests handles that better. Try forcing `servername` in Node options.
Maria V: Example (Node workaround):
```
const https = require('https')
const opts = {
  host: 'proxy.local',
  port: 443,
  method: 'POST',
  path: '/v1/stream',
  headers: { 'Host': 'inference.private.local' },
  servername: 'inference.private.local'
}
const req = https.request(opts)
```
Maria V: Also check `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED` only for debug — don't ship that.
Sam K: Tried setting servername — still saw resets but fewer. Could be retry logic + request id mismatch? Streams get a 502 then client retries and cancels.
Jake L: Our SDK has streaming retry backoff that assumes idempotent connect; when underlying socket is reset we might be canceling. Opened a small repro branch: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk-repro/tree/vpc-stream-reset
infra-bot: NAT route update applied to stg (rtb-01234) — may reduce proxy rewrite latency :robot_face:
Sam K: Nice, re-tested after infra change — Node streams are stable now. Will add a test and a note in docs about SNI/Host precedence.
Maria V: Add a snippet to devex README about env var precedence: `REDWOOD_PRIVATE_ENDPOINT` overrides `REDWOOD_API_BASE` when present.
Jake L: Ping me for code review, will add a unit test for servername plumbing. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: FYI scheduled patch to SDK will roll out tomorrow at 03:00 UTC
Sam K: Thanks everyone!
